questions.question: These 93 DNA sequences (371 sites) evolved along an unknown tree. Treat the tree as unrooted, so a clade here is a split of the taxa into two groups. Which clades would you report as well supported at the 95% level? Report every such clade and no others. The alignment is in the file `alignment.fasta` in the current working directory.
questions.answer_format: one Newick tree of all 93 taxa, on one line, that contains exactly the clades you report: collapse every other branch into a polytomy (no support values or branch lengths needed), e.g. ((t1,t2),t3,(t4,t5,t6),t7);
questions.source: AliSim GTR{1.062/2.268/1.004/1.121/3.938}+F{0.3787/0.1593/0.0881/0.3739}+G4{1.375} on a 93-taxon generating tree, 44 of its 90 internal edges near zero; band = IQ-TREE ModelFinder + UFBoot2 (1000) clades >= 95, precision and recall minus 3 binomial SE

questions.question: The file `sequences.fasta` in the current working directory holds 41 homologous DNA sequences, unaligned; they differ by substitutions and by many insertions and deletions. (a) Infer their phylogeny, treated as unrooted. (b) In a multiple sequence alignment of them, which residue of t6 is in the same column as residue 367 of t15? Count residues from 1, ignoring gaps.
questions.answer_format: the residue number for (b), then ' | ', then the tree for (a) in Newick with all 41 taxa on one line, e.g. 57 | ((t1,t2),t3,(t4,t5));
questions.source: AliSim GTR{1.097/2.726/1.010/1.036/4.312}+F{0.2859/0.2080/0.1422/0.3639}+G4{0.906} --indel 0.05,0.1 on a 41-taxon generating tree; (b) from AliSim's true alignment; (a) nRF tolerance = mean + 3 sd over 20 seeded MAFFT --auto + ML runs (ModelFinder's pick at seed 1, then fitted at seeds 2-20)
